programmes.d: Things get a little buggy when Schwoz installs a new operating system on the Man Cave computer designed to detect and eliminate threats all over Swellview.
Trouble follows Henry to his home when a rock from outer space turns out to be an egg with an alien creature inside it.
When Ray accidentally destroys Henry's dad's prized remote control car, they throw a manicure/pedicure party to raise money to fix it.
Captain Man and Kid Danger find themselves in the middle of a debate about Swellview's favorite snack.
When Piper's school parrot, Otto, starts to repeat that Henry is Kid Danger, Henry and Jasper have to stall until Ray, Charlotte and Schwoz can find a way to fix things.
A 13-year-old boy lands a job as a sidekick to a superhero, and he must now keep his identity a secret.
Henry gets an unexpected visitor claiming to be from the future; when a boy-robot killing machine steps onto the scene, the gang must find a way to save everyone from an apocalyptic future.

Feeling like a third wheel when her teammates find significant others, Lynn seeks a boyfriend just to fit in; Clyde recruits Lincoln and the gang to find out if a girl he has a crush on at school feels the same about him.
After agreeing to go to the Royal Woods House of Terror, Lincoln and Clyde have to toughen up and face their fears; Lola discovers that Lucy has an old, fragile doll and decides she must borrow it.

Mom tries to convince a newspaper editor that her kids are perfect in order to land a parenting advice column job; Luna is hired to watch the McBrides' cat when they go out of town, but the job becomes more demanding than she imagined.

To get out of doing things they don't like, Lana and Lola secretly switch places and pretend to be the other; after causing Flip to get hurt, the kids sneak him into the attic to care for him without Mom and Dad knowing.

When Luna discovers that the high school music club will be axed due to budget cuts, she leads a protest; desperate to play Lincoln's trash-themed video game, Lana conspires to distract her brother away from the console.

Worried that his teacher has bad things to say about him, Lincoln tries to delay his parent-teacher conference; Luan wakes up with a pimple on the day of her first date with Benny, so she turns to the siblings for help.
Lincoln's family forms a band when he signs them up for a talent show; Lincoln's mother offers to take him to the dental office where she works; his sisters go to work with their father.
When Ronnie Anne and Bobby visit their crazy extended family, Bobby fits in great, but Ronnie Anne struggles with the smothering nature of their relatives.

When Lincoln's mother signs him up for peewee football, Lincoln schemes to have Lynn take his spot; Lincoln becomes a hypochondriac when Lucy reads his fortune and predicts that his day will end in disaster.

Ronnie Anne makes friends with Sid, a girl whose family wants to rent the apartment upstairs; when it looks like another couple might get it first, the girls resort to sabotage to try and dissuade them.
Lincoln begins to hog the spotlight when he becomes Luan's clown assistant; the Loud children have fun on a snow day.

When Carl witnesses Ronnie Anne save a dog, he becomes obsessed with being just like his newfound hero; Ronnie Anne secretly starts watching her family's favorite telenovela after refusing to watch it with them.
SpongeBob tries to convince a bouncer that he is tough enough for the Salty Spitoon; Squidward's archenemy returns.
SpongeBob applies for a job as a fry cook at Krusty Krab; Squidward's lawn; SpongeBob meets Sandy Cheeks.
The trio plays a game of hide and seek that spans the globe and takes decades to complete; to get their landlord to lower their rent, the trio tries to help him achieve his impossible dream.

Scissors helps Paper have a weekend interesting enough to impress Pencil; even more exciting: Rock buys a hat; Rock, Paper and Scissors try to prove they shouldn't be replaced by their incredible new friend, Putty.
When Timmy's father is too busy to spend time with him, he wishes for more fathers; the Squirrelly Scouts and the Cream Puffs race to the top of Mount Doom.
Poof must stop his anti-fairy from destroying the Fairy World and his loved ones.
Timmy tries to thwart his parents' plans for his birthday party; Timmy discovers that his mother wants to spend time with him.
Timmy tries to help Catman find a safer job; Timmy's mother turns their house into a bed and breakfast.
Vicky gets fired from babysitting Timmy; Timmy wishes for a super girlfriend for the Crimson Chin.
Timmy wishes for Chip Skylark's voice in order to win the lead in the school play; Timmy and Vicky are trapped in a cave after an avalanche hits Mt. Dimmsdale.
Timmy enters Cosmo and Wanda as goldfish in a contest at school; Timmy wishes his long forgotten imaginary friend to life.
Problems occur when Timmy leaves his Crimson Chin comic on the side of his bathtub; Timmy wishes for the height and skills of a basketball superstar.
Timmy wishes that the entire world would be quiet; Chester and A.J. are suspicious of Timmy's sudden popularity.
Timmy wishes for master kung-fu skills in order to fight a bully; Timmy travels back in time and encounters a crazed witch-hunter.
Timmy goes back in time to try to change Mr. Crocker's past so that he will be a happier person in the present.
Timmy wishes that nobody needs sleep; Timmy thinks his parents would be better off without him so he wishes that he wasn't their son.
Timmy wishes he were the most wanted kid in America; Mama Cosma gets her son onto a Fairyworld television program.
Timmy wishes he was his father's sports car; Timmy accidentally releases the Crimson Chin's arch-villain, the Anti-Chin, into our world.
Timmy wishes for a special car wash that will make his father's sports car look younger; Wanda is worried that Poof does not interact with other fairy babies.
Timmy's parents find Poof and are convinced that he is an alien super baby; Jorgen takes Timmy to a rehabilitation facility to get him to learn to wish less and be more independent.
Evil princess Mandie plots to marry Mark Chang and become ruler of Yugopotamia; Dark Laser offers Timmy a scholarship to Dark Mouth University in order to turn him into his evil apprentice.
Timmy wishes for a machine that allows him to merge with other items to become half-Timmy and half-something else; when Timmy wishes for a simpler world, everyone is transported to prehistoric times.
After Timmy wishes for a talking car, he goes on an adventure in Fairy World with Wanda, Poof and "Carsmo"; Timmy convinces Cosmo and Wanda to give him his own magic wand with 10 wishes on it.

Timmy convinces the fairies, anti-fairies and pixies to participate in a competition to see who is best.
Timmy goes to the hospital to have his tonsils removed; Timmy wishes to see his favorite baseball team.
Timmy offers to baby-sit so that Cosmo and Wanda can have a night out; Timmy wishes for indestructible hair.
Timmy, Cosmo and Wanda find themselves trapped in a bedtime story; Timmy wishes that a substitute teacher could be his permanent teacher.
Timmy must stay with Grandpa Pappy while his parents are out of town; Timmy finds his father's favorite childhood book series.
Timmy wishes he were a fish; Timmy wishes for a device that would allow him to change places with anyone.
SpongeBob and Patrick intrude upon Squidward's day off; Squidward becomes obsessed with winning a stuffed animal from the skill crane.
Plankton invents a machine enabling him to switch lives with Mr. Krabs; SpongeBob volunteers for lifeguard duty.
Timmy wishes for a scholarship to military school; Timmy's father tries to help him with his homework.
Timmy wishes for the perfect older brother; Timmy wishes that everything in school were mixed up like a puzzle book.
Wanda must run the family business when Big Daddy is kidnapped; Timmy wishes his mother could sell a house to anyone.
In order for Sprig Speevak to become a space hero, he must first survive the perils of space high school.
Timmy wishes for super magician powers to perform at the fair; Timmy, Cosmo and Wanda are invited to a party at Cupid's house.
Timmy wishes the trash away; Timmy becomes the subject of a reality show.
Remy wants Timmy to be his best friend; Timmy sneaks into the castle in Cosmo and Wanda's fishbowl.
Mr. Crocker receives the magic lava lamp as a present; Jorgen plans to use Timmy's tooth as an engagement ring for the Tooth Fairy.
